title: Again with the mall
content: I’m so tired of these mall dreams. I wake up exhausted and stressed about it. My mall is pretty cool tbh and not scary, just very big and not well planned. There are a ton of escalators and sometimes kids rides. Last night was unusual because I kept blundering into off limit areas (like behind the counter). There was also a large wedding reception group I was trying to avoid because they were all loud and drunk. This mall had a nice library and I sat down to eat(!) and realized I needed salad dressing and a copy of The New Yorker. That’s when I got lost. I bet someone stole my salad and backpack by now.
